explication: MarkEdit is a native macOS Markdown editor whose principal workflow opens a text document, edits and formats it in an embedded CodeMirror-based editor, and saves it through macOS document handling. The repository separates the native app shell from the TypeScript editor and connects them through bridges. README-described capabilities also include Quick Look, extensions, Shortcuts and AppleScript, text statistics, and automatic updates. Some subsystem links rely on the documented product capabilities and tree; sampled source is limited, so uncertain internal call wiring is omitted.
